name: @dotlocker/workspace
description: dot.locker workspace for secure runtime-scoped file storage, synchronization, and administration.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @dotlocker/shared exec rune build && pnpm --filter @dotlocker/client exec rune build && pnpm --filter @dotlocker/server exec rune build && pnpm --filter @dotlocker/ui exec rune build && pnpm --filter @dotlocker/ui-shared exec rune build && pnpm --filter @dotlocker/site exec rune build && pnpm --filter @dotlocker/webui exec rune build && pnpm --filter @dotlocker/dotlocker exec rune build && pnpm exec tsc -p packages/apps/mcp/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @dotlocker/client exec rune test && pnpm --filter @dotlocker/server exec rune test && pnpm --filter @dotlocker/dotlocker exec rune test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @dotlocker/client exec rune typecheck && pnpm --filter @dotlocker/server exec rune typecheck && pnpm --filter @dotlocker/dotlocker exec rune typecheck && pnpm exec tsc -p packages/apps/mcp/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @dotlocker/client exec rune lint && pnpm --filter @dotlocker/server exec rune lint
scripts.format: pnpm --filter @dotlocker/client exec rune format && pnpm --filter @dotlocker/server exec rune format
